name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food truck orders & kitchen
promotionalText: Take orders in advance, protect the kitchen from too many orders and keep selling when the signal is gone. The ordering app for food truck teams.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool your team runs service with.

Customers pre-order and choose a collection time. Your team sees every order on one screen, confirms what the kitchen can prepare, and then marks it as ready and collected.

NEVER PROMISE A TIME YOU CAN’T KEEP
Set how much your kitchen can prepare at the same time and how long it takes. When a collection time is fully booked, customers can no longer choose it – so the queue matches the kitchen.

TAKE ORDERS ON THE SPOT
Enter on-the-spot (walk-up) orders on the same screen as pre-orders, so the kitchen works with a single queue.

ONE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen monitor shows what needs preparing now, what comes next and what is ready – with an alert when an order needs to be started.

PRINT ORDER TICKETS
Connect a receipt printer in the kitchen via Bluetooth or over your local network, and order tickets are printed automatically.

KEEP SELLING WHEN THE SIGNAL IS GONE
Switch on offline protection: if the connection drops, pre-orders are paused so nobody places an order you don’t see. Orders you take on the device stay saved and are synced as soon as you are back online.

MADE FOR THE FOOD TRUCK
Use the app on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on during service, get notified when an order needs confirming, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

PLAN YOUR WEEK
Set up your events and locations once and take orders for every event and every location.

HatchGrab is for food truck operators and their team. You need a HatchGrab account to sign in.
